A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
